failure_summary.description: Returned an expanded or alternate name form where the expected answer was the generic term or the conventional English name.
Selected a related carrying vessel instead of the requested structure where the burning occurred.

patch.reasoning: The skill already calls for concise answers and careful relation tracking, but these failures show the need for a sharper test of generic terms versus named occurrences and of an object's role in a clue. A separate name-form tie-break addresses the supported Italian/English variants without repeating the existing general naming rule.

edits.target: Before answering, parse the requested answer slot and all identifying relations or properties, then test the candidate against the complete clue. When snippets compete, prefer factual evidence that fits those details; keyword overlap in a title or heading, prominence, or a similar name alone is not enough. Do not substitute a related entity, example, remedy, or mechanism for the requested answer.
edits.content: Before answering, identify the requested answer slot and grammatical head, then check that the candidate is the kind of thing the clue asks for. If the clue asks for a general term or type and cites a particular occurrence only to identify it, return the conventional generic headword rather than an expanded label for that occurrence; add a modifier only when the specific named subtype is requested. For a functionally described object, ensure the candidate itself fills the stated role rather than being an associated carrier, container, or support. Test the candidate against the complete clue. When snippets compete, prefer factual evidence that fits those details; keyword overlap in a title or heading, prominence, or a similar name alone is not enough. Do not substitute a related entity, example, remedy, or mechanism for the requested answer.

edits.target: Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer, and include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.
edits.content: Use the context-supported conventional form of a name or answer. When context gives equivalent local-language and English forms, prefer the conventional form in the question's language unless the clue explicitly requests the local or original form. Include additional name parts only when needed to distinguish otherwise-confusable entities.
